'''January 2000 Montreal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Montreal, Quebec on 9 January 2000. [[Francis Savaria]] won it. It is known from Dominic Gaudreault's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d165">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-quebec-montreal-09-01-00d165/ quebec-montreal-09-01-00], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 9 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-quebec-montreal-09-01-00d165/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Montreal, Quebec
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Francis Savaria]]
